title: Ashgrove CareAssure Issue, Monthly Maximum and Placement Rules
content:
Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance — issue rules for the Ashgrove CareAssure tiers.

1. **Issue limits.** A tier is issued only within its issue ages and with a specified amount between its smallest and largest specified amount, on one of its premium options (single premium or ten-pay).
2. **Monthly maximum at issue.** The monthly maximum benefit at issue is the specified amount divided by the tier's acceleration period months, rounded to the cent.
3. **Acceleration pool.** The long-term care acceleration pool opened at issue equals the specified amount.
4. **Inflation protection.** The 5 percent compound inflation option is available only at issue ages up to the tier's highest issue age for that option. Inflation options are chosen at issue and cannot be added later.
5. **Lapse-notice designee.** At application the owner names a third party to receive lapse notices, or waives the designation in writing.
6. **Placement.** A ten-pay policy is placed In Force when delivered with the first installment paid. A single premium policy is placed Paid Up when delivered with the premium paid.
7. **Policy loans.** Policy loans are not offered on a tier whose specification shows policy loans as not available, and every CareAssure tier shows them as not available.
8. **Declined or withdrawn applications.** A declined or withdrawn application has any premium refunded in full, and the policy record shows Declined.

**Record effects of issue.** An issued policy stands as Applied until it is placed. On issue the first premium — the single premium or the first ten-pay installment — is billed with the issue date as its due date, the acceleration pool is opened, and the original beneficiary designation takes effect on the issue date.

**Per-tier figures this rule reads**

| Tier | Issue ages | Specified amount | Acceleration period months | Highest issue age, 5 percent option |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 40 to 79 | $50000 to $1000000 | 24 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 40 to 79 | $50000 to $1000000 | 24 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 40 to 79 | $50000 to $1000000 | 24 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 40 to 77 | $50000 to $1000000 | 24 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 40 to 75 | $50000 to $1000000 | 24 | 70 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 40 to 70 | $100000 to $500000 | 24 | 65 |

**Monthly maximum at issue — worked figures (hypothetical specified amounts)**

| Specified amount | Divided by 24 months | Monthly maximum, rounded to the cent | Acceleration pool at issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| $50000 | $2083.3333 | $2083.33 | $50000 |
| $100000 | $4166.6666 | $4166.67 | $100000 |
| $250000 | $10416.6666 | $10416.67 | $250000 |

**Inflation choice at issue — cases (hypothetical insureds).** An insured aged 68 at issue of an Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year may be issued the 5 percent compound option; the same insured at issue of an Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime may not, because 68 exceeds 65. An owner who chose no inflation protection at issue cannot add an option later.
